summary: Full end-to-end testing (backend + frontend) of Paycheck Planner MVP. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed against public URL. Frontend: All 4 tabs (Dashboard, Planner, Bills/Calendar, Tracker), month chip selection, paycheck detail navigation, and bill paid toggle all functional. No red-screen errors. YTD totals match spec (income $22,276; 100 bills).

issues: Bottom tab label says 'Bills' but the screen header says 'Bill Calendar'. Review request refers to it as the 'Calendar tab'. Minor naming inconsistency - either rename tab to 'Calendar' or update docs.

action_items: Optional: Align tab label ('Bills') with the screen title ('Bill Calendar') and the review-request naming ('Calendar tab') for consistency.

Optional: Paycheck 2 for Sept shows BUFFER of $-596.88 (negative) because bills exceed the paycheck's current_month_bills allocation. This may be intentional (mirrors workbook) but consider styling negative buffers in red to alert the user.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); recommend migrating to lifespan context manager in a future iteration.
Auto-seed on startup runs on every backend restart guarded by count check - good idempotency.
All responses correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection {"_id": 0}.
seed_data_creation: Data auto-seeded by backend on startup (4 months, 17 paychecks, 100 bills for Sept-Dec 2026). Verified via GET /api/summary returning ytd_income=22276 and bills_total=100.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers seed idempotency, months list/detail, paycheck GET/PATCH, bill PATCH, and YTD summary. Frontend testIDs: dashboard-screen, month-chip-{key}, paycheck-card-{id}, calendar-screen, calendar-month-{key}, bill-row-{id}, tracker-paycheck-{id}. Bottom tabs are text-based (Dashboard/Planner/Bills/Tracker) without dedicated tab testIDs - use get_by_text(...).last for navigation.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. MVP fully functional.
